business_scope.primary_industry_name: Visual Web Template and Low-Code Web Application Builder

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Oman (national unitary jurisdiction; no sub-state tax distinction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States–Oman Free Trade Agreement, in force 1 January 2009
Oman–United Kingdom Agreement for the Promotion and Protection of Investments, signed 1983, in force 1984
Oman–India Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement, in force 1998
GCC Unified Economic Agreement and GCC Common Market, applicable to Oman as a GCC member

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Commercial Companies Law, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, and Executive Regulations issued by MOCIIP Ministerial Decision No. 4/2020; Foreign Capital Investment Law, Royal Decree No. 50/2019; Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Law, Royal Decree No. 30/2016, as amended; applicable Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT rules; MOCIIP directives and forms on beneficial owner registration and commercial name clearance; Omani notarization and consular authentication practice.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign Parent Shareholder: Commercial Registration Extract / Certificate of Incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies Registry in the parent shareholder's jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization; origin-state Ministry of Foreign Affairs authentication; Sultanate of Oman Embassy/Consulate attestation, or Hague Apostille where both jurisdictions are Apostille Contracting States; followed by certified Arabic translation accepted by MOCIIP

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign Parent: Memorandum and Articles of Association / Constitutional Documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent-company registrar or notary public, certified true copy
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization chain as above; certified Arabic translation by a licensed Omani legal translator

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign Parent: Board Resolution Approving Incorporation of the Oman SPC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Parent company board or secretary, certified by a notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization or apostille, as applicable, followed by certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign Parent: Certificate of Good Standing
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular legalization or apostille, as applicable, followed by certified Arabic translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney in Favour of Omani Resident Agent / Counsel
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the parent jurisdiction or a licensed Omani notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: If signed abroad, notarization and consular legalization/apostille followed by Arabic translation; if signed in Oman, notarization by a licensed Omani notary public only

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration, AML/KYC Forms, Passport Copies and Proof of Address for Each Ultimate Beneficial Owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Authorized compliance officer / law firm, supported by notarized UBO passport copies
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization only for domestic Omani declarations; foreign-language passport pages must be accompanied by a certified Arabic summary translation

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-acceptance screening of all shareholders, directors, and ultimate beneficial owners against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, UK OFI consolidated list, EU consolidated financial sanctions list, INTERPOL red notices, and Oman's domestic AML/CFT blacklist. Enhanced due diligence is required for PEPs, their family members, and close associates. For this low-risk no-code website builder business, ongoing KYC, source-of-funds verification, and transaction monitoring remain mandatory.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Sijilat – MOCIIP E-Services Portal at business.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All commercial names must be filed in Arabic; the Arabic name governs legal identity and transliteration from English must be submitted using the approved Arabic rendering. The SPC designation must be included. English-only names, numeric-only names, and names likely to mislead as to the company's activity are rejected. Names must not duplicate an existing registered name, violate public order, or imply governmental, royal, religious, or charitable sponsorship.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 30 days of an electronic rejection in Sijilat, the applicant may either file a corrected re-submission under a new name-search record or submit a written administrative grievance to the Commercial Registration Directorate at MOCIIP with a name-search certificate and supporting justification. If the grievance is rejected, the applicant may petition the competent Administrative Court within 60 days of the adverse decision. A name containing a prohibited or sensitive token is appealable only after obtaining the prior no-objection of the relevant ministerial or licensing authority. Extension of an approved reservation may be requested within the last five days of the reservation window for one additional 30-day period; failure to file the incorporation application within the reservation term forfeits name priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only if a physical serviced office or co-working address with a dedicated service contract is maintained in Oman and registered as the SPC's head office with MOCIIP. A pure virtual mailbox, PO Box, or director's home address will not satisfy the actual-head-office requirement for a foreign-owned SPC. The no-code website builder activity requires no separate regulatory license, but municipal commercial-license approval of the registered address remains mandatory.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for ordinary ISIC 6201 no-code website-building SPCs, approximately below 5% unannounced MOCIIP or municipal physical inspection in a given operating year. If only a virtual or serviced office address is used, the likelihood increases to approximately 15–25%, and the company must retain documented commercial substance such as the serviced-office agreement, board records, client contracts, and local agent availability.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Commercial Companies Law and MOCIIP registration fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Municipal commercial activity license for ISIC 6201 software-publishing and web-template building
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent governorate municipality, e.g., Muscat Municipality

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO register filing and AML/CFT/KYC pre-clearance compliance pack
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Ministerial UBO filing fee and prevailing market AML compliance retainer

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for a low-risk technology SPC

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Omani corporate counsel drafting and filing supervision for SPC formation, powers of attorney, and board resolutions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark fixed fee for foreign-owned SPC establishment

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree No. 18/2019), provisions applicable to limited liability companies and single-person companies; Foreign Capital Investment Law (Royal Decree No. 50/2019) and its implementing regulations; Executive Regulations of the Commercial Registration System.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP), Commercial Registration Directorate; electronic filing through the Invest Easy portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registration Certificate (Sijil) issued via the Invest Easy national registration system.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a Single Person Company under the Oman Commercial Companies Law. The shareholder must however deposit committed capital in the SPC's bank account with a licensed Omani bank and submit a bank certificate or capital confirmation letter. No statutory escrow account is required; funds must remain available to the company and may not be withdrawn while the company is solvent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation and Foreign Investment Pre-approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create an Invest Easy account, select Single Person Company, submit a proposed Arabic or Arabic/English trade name, and answer the Foreign Capital Investment Law questionnaire. Obtain preliminary clearance confirming the name is available and the proposed foreign ownership structure is permitted.
required_dossiers: Passport copy of the natural person shareholder or certified board resolution of the corporate shareholder
Registered agent or legal representative power of attorney
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for conflict or public-policy reasons, submit up to three revised alternatives within five business days; no formal appeal is available at this stage, but a written objection may be filed with the MoCIIP commercial registration committee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Legalization of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public under the Ministry of Justice and Legal Affairs; Oman Ministry of Foreign Affairs attestation for foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the SPC Constitution and English translation, have the shareholder or authorised attorney sign before a licensed notary, and ensure all foreign corporate records are legalized at the Oman embassy in the jurisdiction of origin, translated into Arabic, and notarized.
required_dossiers: SPC Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association) in Arabic
Notarized shareholder consent or corporate board resolution
Oman-legalized certificate of incorporation and good standing (if corporate shareholder)
Arabic notarized translation of foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or attestation chain is incomplete, cure by obtaining apostille or Oman embassy legalization, re-translating the document into Arabic before a sworn translator, and resubmitting through the same notary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Bank Account Opening and Paid-up Capital Deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank licensed by the Central Bank of Oman
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a pre-incorporation or designated SPC bank account with a licensed Omani bank, complete client due diligence and AML screening, deposit the committed capital, and obtain an official capital deposit certificate or bank letter stating the available balance.
required_dossiers: Draft constitutional documents and notarized power of attorney
Provisional name reservation certificate from MoCIIP
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requires enhanced due diligence, provide auditable source of funds, shareholder net-worth evidence, and an organizational chart; if rejected, open the account at another licensed Omani bank and submit the revised capital certificate to Invest Easy.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Incorporation Application and Issue of Commercial Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registration Directorate through Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the single-person company incorporation application, upload the notarized constitution, capital certificate, name reservation, and shareholder identity records, pay the applicable government fees, and receive the electronic Commercial Registration Certificate (Sijil) with company registration number.
required_dossiers: Passport or corporate ID of the shareholder
Notarized power of attorney and owner consent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a query or deficiency notice, cure by submitting corrected documents through Invest Easy within fifteen days; if the application is rejected, file an administrative objection with MoCIIP within thirty days and re-submit the perfected file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance and Statutory Record Set-up
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registry; Oman Tax Authority; Muscat Municipality; Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the first board resolution, prepare the share register, minutes book, corporate seal, and manager appointment letter; register with the Oman Chamber of Commerce, obtain a tax identification number from the Oman Tax Authority, and complete General Authority for Social Insurance registration only when employees are hired.
required_dossiers: Lease contract or proof of registered office address
Passport copies and photographs of officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If late-registration or posting penalties arise, pay the nominal late fee at Invest Easy and, for tax registration, submit voluntary disclosure to the Oman Tax Authority before the first filing deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Office Occupancy and Non-Industrial Licensing Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality or relevant local municipality; Royal Oman Police Civil Defense Directorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: If a physical office is leased for the software activity, obtain a municipal commercial operating permit based on the commercial registration certificate, complete civil defense fire-safety inspection for the office, and ensure the premises are used exclusively for administrative and digital services with no industrial or manufacturing activity.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the municipality or civil defense queries the application, remedy fire-safety deficiencies, correct zoning use classification, pay municipal inspection fees, and resubmit the amended application with a new civil defense approval letter.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable — no industrial license is required for ISIC 6201 computer programming and software publishing activity; the competent authority for general commercial registration is MoCIIP.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable — no sector-specific operational or manufacturing permit applies to no-code website development; a municipal commercial license may be required for the administrative office only.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the activity is a purely digital and administrative software development operation and does not constitute a project requiring an Environmental Impact Assessment or an Environmental Site Audit.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No wastewater, VOC, or point-source industrial emissions are generated. The office must comply with municipal waste-disposal and sewerage standards, and any electronic waste or obsolete IT equipment must be transferred to a licensed e-waste recycler.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The leased office must obtain a Civil Defense fire-safety certificate, structural load and occupancy approval from the building municipality, and an occupational safety clearance confirming emergency exits, fire extinguishers, electrical safety, and compliance with Oman's workplace safety standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Sultanate of Oman Tax Authority (OTA), headquartered in Muscat; all registrations, filings and certifications are processed through the OTA e-Tax/e-services portal accessible via the official domain taxoman.gov.om.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: 1) Incorporate the foreign-owned Single Person Company (SPC) with the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) via the Invest Easy platform, obtaining the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate and Omani Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) membership. 2) Register with the OTA for Corporate Income Tax within 3 months of CR issuance or commencement of business to obtain the Tax Identification Number (TIN). 3) Register for VAT (obtaining a VAT Registration Number) when taxable supplies in any 12-month period reach or are expected to reach OMR 38,500; voluntary VAT registration is permitted from OMR 19,250. 4) If physical goods are ever exported, activate the Bayan customs account of the Royal Oman Police Directorate General of Customs; pure SaaS/no-code digital exports require no customs activation. No additional statutory licence is required for the stated business scope.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — the SPC is a resident Omani juridical person fully subject to Corporate Income Tax on worldwide income; no pass-through or fiscal-transparency treatment is recognised; 100% foreign ownership of an SPC is permitted under the Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019). Distributions to the non-resident single shareholder attract 10% withholding tax unless reduced by an applicable Double Taxation Agreement; no free-zone or special-economic-zone exemption is presumed absent an OPAZ/SEZAD qualifying licence.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Oman administers no check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch classification election. Available elections include: (i) voluntary VAT registration at the OMR 19,250 threshold to recover input VAT; (ii) VAT tax-group treatment for related persons under the VAT Law; (iii) the concessional 3% CIT rate for qualifying Omani small-enterprise taxpayers; (iv) treaty-based withholding tax relief where the SPC obtains an Omani tax residence certificate; and (v) free-zone/Special Economic Zone at Duqm CIT holiday only upon obtaining a qualifying zone licence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) levied under the GCC Unified VAT Agreement, implemented by Royal Decree 121/2020 (Oman VAT Law) and the VAT Executive Regulations
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory registration: OMR 38,500 of taxable supplies in the preceding 12 months or expected in the following 12 months; voluntary registration: OMR 19,250. Non-resident suppliers of digital services to Omani consumers must register irrespective of threshold, as the reverse charge does not apply to B2C digital supplies.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The OTA is phasing in a mandatory e-invoicing framework on a GCC Peppol-aligned model. Tax invoices must be issued through OTA-approved fiscal systems in structured machine-readable format (XML/JSON), transmitted for real-time or near-real-time validation and clearance on a phased timetable, and must include a dynamic QR code, the VAT Registration Number, and line-level tax data. The SPC must retain an OTA-compliant digital invoice ledger available for automated audit review.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods are zero-rated upon proof of customs export. For the no-code/low-code SaaS business, 0% VAT applies to: (i) cross-border supplies of software platform subscriptions, hosting, and digital builder services to customers resident outside the GCC where the effective benefit and use are outside Oman; (ii) B2B supplies to VAT-registered businesses in other GCC states, subject to destination-state reverse-charge; and (iii) services ancillary to qualifying exports. B2C supplies to GCC-resident individuals are taxable in the customer's GCC state and may create foreign VAT registration obligations. The claimant must retain the contract, evidence of the customer's foreign business/VAT status, geo-usage evidence, and overseas payment records.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate / Bank Credit Advice
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Omani tax legislation does not impose an express 180-day FX repatriation deadline; the 180-day benchmark is applied as documentary-settlement guidance for export zero-rating audit defence. On audit, the OTA examines the full chain: export declarations, transport documents, contracts, payment flows, and use-and-enjoyment indicators. Missing or inconsistent evidence recharacterises the supply at 5% VAT, triggering monthly late-payment penalties, interest, and full clawback of refunds. Deliberate misuse of export zero-rating constitutes tax evasion under the VAT Law: administrative fines up to OMR 25,000 per offence, imprisonment up to 3 years, suspension of the VAT certificate, and publication in the OTA defaulters' register.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Omani Rial (OMR) is fully convertible and pegged to the US dollar at approximately 1 USD = 0.3845 OMR. Current-account transactions are unrestricted, and there are no exchange controls on capital movement, profit repatriation, or foreign-currency holdings. Foreign-owned SPCs may freely transfer dividends, liquidation proceeds, and loan repayments out of Oman, subject only to standard anti-money-laundering verification and tax-clearance evidence where applicable. No prior CBO approval is needed for remittance, except for transactions requiring screening under CBO AML/CFT regulations or economic-sanctions frameworks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Oman does not impose forced surrender or mandatory conversion of export proceeds. Exporters under an SPC structure may retain foreign-currency receipts in CBO-licensed bank accounts at Omani commercial banks or use such proceeds directly for offshore operating expenses. There is no statutory repatriation deadline or conversion ratio; export earnings must only be supported by underlying commercial invoices and lodged in accordance with the bank's documentation policy.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore digital EMI bank accounts to serve as the primary settlement rail. The Central Bank of Oman licenses only CBO-regulated banks and, since the Payments Law, licensed payment service providers to hold pooled funds and execute local payment transfers. Foreign electronic-money institutions and fintech EMIs do not have automatic passporting into Oman and cannot open local settlement/collection accounts without a CBO-licensed branch or partnership with a licensed Omani bank. They may be used as an auxiliary USD collection rail for international customers, but all OMR-denominated local disbursements and payroll must be settled through CBO-licensed banks.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: A physical presence requirement applies at final account-opening stage. The director, beneficial owner with explicit control, or appointed authorized signatory must attend at least one in-person meeting at the Omani bank branch for biometric AML verification, original-document attestation, and counter-signing of account mandates. Remote video KYC may support the preliminary risk assessment, but the original commercial registration, CR certificate, and board resolution must be physically produced; a corporate services provider or attorney acting under notarised power may attend only if the bank expressly permits and full UBO identity is verified.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Lack of visible commercial substance in Oman (no employee, no office, pure offshore digital business)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed SPC lease agreement or hotel-office/concierge agreement, audited or management accounts, board resolution appointing registered agent, and a detailed evergreen business plan showing the software platform, recurring revenue model, and transaction flows using Stripe/Paddle as payment gateways.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Insufficient beneficial-ownership documentation for the 100% foreign corporate shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified certificates of incorporation of parent entities, ultimate controller passport copies, offshore register extract, chain-of-ownership diagram, and notarized sworn declarations confirming source of funds and source of wealth for the injected share capital.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk geography or sanctions exposure of the payment gateway / customer base
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IP address geo-exclusion policy, commercially acceptable sanctions-screen log, published underwriting rules, Standard Contractual Clauses for customer data, and an external auditor attestation confirming the system excludes OFAC/UN-listed jurisdictions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear source of foreign-currency capital flowing into the SPC account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: SWIFT MT103 copies, remitter bank verification, purpose code annotation 'Foreign Direct Investment — Equity Capital', third-party contract for the no-code builder services, shareholder loan agreement if funds are pushed as debt, and prior tax filings of the parent entity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use a standard SWIFT MT103 wire transfer from the parent entity's corporate bank to the SPC's Omani commercial bank account. The remittance advice must set out the IMF BPM6 purpose code for foreign direct investment (equity) and the narration 'Paid-up share capital of SPC under Oman Commercial Companies Law'. The bank will require the account name to match the registered SPC name, the ultimate beneficial owner declaration, and the CR/sanctions screening. Funds in USD are normally settled same-day through the clearing network, then converted to OMR at the pegged rate if the operating account is OMR-denominated.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements follow normal Omani banking clearing rails: outward SWIFT MT103 instructs for software-licence vendor fees, contractor invoices, and cloud/SaaS costs; commercial letters of credit (sight or usance) are the mandated rail for physical infrastructure procurement and any equipment import. For recurring operating expenses such as hosting costs, the SPC may set up standing irrevocable payment orders with CBO-licensed banks; cross-border SWIFT messages must cite the relevant sub-ledger invoice and obtain a pre-disbursement cold check. Local disbursements for Omani employees and suppliers are settled via the Automated Clearing House (ACH) or direct credit instructions controlled by the CBO.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/OMR spot and outright forward contracts for converting excess USD into OMR at the pegged rate
Currency swaps between major convertible currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) for non-USD revenue and supplier obligations
Plain-vanilla FX forward contracts for hedged collection via Stripe/Paddle
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps on any future commercial-loan tranches (subject to CBO-approved risk-management policy)

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are generally disfavoured against the OMR because the currency is firmly pegged; only in exceptional circumstances with a documented real commercial exposure may a bank provide a non-USD NDF hedge without creating a speculative position

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MCIIP) – Commercial Registrar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: During the anniversary month of the original commercial registration; renewal must be completed on or before the expiry date of the current certificate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-renewal penalty of OMR 10 (≈ USD 26) per month is applied; if renewal is not completed within 6 months of the due date, the commercial registration may be administratively struck-off and the company dissolved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MCIIP – Commercial Registry (same online portal as renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Must be submitted simultaneously with the annual commercial renewal; also due within 14 days of any change in the beneficial ownership chain
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or providing false information in the UBO confirmation is punishable by a fine under MD 48/2019; the registry may issue a formal warning and suspend the company's commercial license until compliance is achieved.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MCIIP – Commercial Registry (archival copy) and General Secretariat of Taxation (for tax assessment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after approval by the sole shareholder and no later than 3 months from the end of the financial year (typically 31 December)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission of audited financial statements may attract an administrative fine by the MCIIP and a separate fine by the tax authority; repeated non-compliance can lead to suspension of the company's commercial registration and disqualification of the responsible officer.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All Oman Single Person Companies (SPCs) are statutorily required to have their annual financial statements audited by an auditor licensed in Oman. No general turnover-, revenue-, or asset-based exemption applies to SPCs under the Oman Commercial Companies Law (Royal Decree 18/2019).
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Oman Accounting Standards (OAS) aligned with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as adopted by the Oman Chartered Accountants Panel (OCAP). IFRS 1 applies to first-time adopters.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Oman Beneficial Ownership Regulations (MD 48/2019, as amended), every SPC must maintain a register of its ultimate beneficial owners and submit an annual confirmation concurrently with the annual commercial renewal. Additionally, any change in ownership or control must be filed with the Commercial Registry within 14 days of the change. The annual UBO confirmation serves as the official annual declaration of the beneficial ownership structure.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of shareholder and director resolutions

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500 – USD 1,200 (annual fee charged by registered-office/agent service providers in Oman for a standard SPC)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800 – USD 1,500 (typical fee for a low-risk non-licensed SPC with basic web development turnover and standard transactions)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general tax holiday applies. Qualifying small and medium-sized enterprises may benefit from a reduced 3% preferential rate on the applicable statutory threshold of taxable income; all other taxable income is subject to the 15% headline rate. Standard deductions for depreciation, research and development expenditure, charitable contributions, and statutory employee benefit costs reduce the effective rate. Foreign-owned SPC entities are taxed on the same unified 15% base as Omani-owned capital companies under the current Income Tax Law (Royal Decree 53/2023).

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form CIT-1 (Income Tax Return for Capital Companies and SPCs), submitted through the Oman Tax Authority e-Tax Portal (EServices Portal) at the official taxation website.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within four calendar months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year SPC the return is due by 30 April unless a different accounting period has been approved by the Oman Tax Authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification: SPC commercial registration number, tax card number, and corporate legal form designation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Oman company registration of the SPC; the foreign corporate shareholder should be identified in the attached shareholder annex and not as the filing taxpayer unless the SPC is treated as a transparent branch.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period start and end dates.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the audited or internally prepared financial statements covering a 12-month period; align dates exactly to the SPC books.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax residency declaration and tax status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SPC, being incorporated in Oman, is resident and must declare full Omani tax residence. The 100% foreign shareholder must not be listed as resident on the SPC return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from all business activities, including subscription fees, SaaS platform sales, Stripe and Paddle settlement revenues, and ancillary services.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Revenue from foreign end-users is taxable if derived through the Oman resident SPC; no home-office reduction is permitted for a resident SPC.
Only include items expressly exempt under Omani income tax law; capital gains on unlisted Omani shares may be exempt under conditions. Digital-service income does not qualify as automatically exempt.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating expenses: cloud hosting, software development, employee salaries, legal and accounting fees, rent, depreciation, and advertising.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support every deduction with invoices and bank settlement records. Payments made to related foreign service providers must be arm's length and may be subject to withholding on the non-resident recipient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income after adding-back disallowed expenses and applying available allowances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign management fees and cross-border related-party charges must be verified against transfer pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax loss carryforward claimed in the current year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only five prior tax years may be imported; a shareholding continuity test and activity continuity test may apply.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax payable computed at the 15% statutory rate, or 3% preferential rate if the SPC qualifies as a small enterprise entity.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Compute tax in OMR; no dividend repatriation adjustment is allowed because Oman does not levy dividend withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance tax payments, foreign tax credits, and withholding tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach credit certificates if the SPC has foreign-source income taxed abroad; treaty relief for foreign taxes must be claimed with the return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers an administrative fine plus a daily surcharge on the unpaid tax; late payment accrues periodic interest charges up to the statutory cap. Persistent failure can result in estimated assessment, increased tax, and referral for enforced collection, including freezing of bank accounts and seizure of assets.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Because Oman imposes no dividend withholding tax, no DTA filing is needed for dividend repatriation. For interest and royalty payments, the non-resident recipient must provide an original Tax Residency Certificate issued by the treaty jurisdiction, file the Oman DTA relief application with the Oman Tax Authority, submit a beneficial ownership declaration, and obtain approval before the payor applies a reduced withholding rate. The Omani SPC is generally required to withhold the statutory 10% rate pending treaty approval.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Oman's statutory withholding tax rate is 10% for royalties and 10% for debt interest payable to non-residents. Under applicable double taxation agreements, treaty rates commonly range from 0% to 10% for interest and 0% to 10% for royalties, conditional on beneficial ownership and economic substance.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: OMR 1,000,000 in aggregate related-party transactions during the tax year triggers mandatory Local File and Master File documentation; a transfer pricing disclosure must be attached to the annual CIT-1 return for transactions above this threshold.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Oman has not enacted UAE-style standalone Economic Substance Regulations; however, the Oman Tax Authority applies substance-over-form, the general anti-abuse rule, place-of-effective-management analysis, and the beneficial-ownership condition under treaties. A foreign-owned no-code SaaS SPC must maintain physical premises, staff, management decisions, accounting records, and operational activity in Oman; a shell SPC constructed solely to collect SaaS revenue is disregarded and denied treaty protection.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-reporting subscription and platform settlement revenue from Stripe and Paddle, issuing false invoices, or recording personal expenses as corporate deductions to reduce taxable income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Imprisonment for up to five years and a fine of up to OMR 10,000, together with recovery of tax under-assessed, late-payment surcharges, and administrative penalties of up to 100% of evaded tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the SPC manager can be jointly and severally liable for the tax debt when the SPC is a mere instrumentality. Personal civil restitution, asset seizure, travel bans, and imprisonment are available statutory remedies.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and No Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Registering the Omani SPC with a nominee manager, no physical office, no employees, no board-level decision-making in Oman, and routing all digital revenue directly to a foreign parent or shareholder while claiming Omani corporate identity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Oman Tax Authority may disregard the corporate personality, annul the tax registration, reassess tax on a deemed profit margin, deny DTA benefits, and impose fines for false declaration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The veil will be pierced; the directing mind is personally liable for the full tax shortfall, restitution of distributions made under the artificial structure, travel restriction, and criminal prosecution for fraudulent use of the corporate entity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and Economic Substance / Beneficial Owner Breach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain the SPC's beneficial ownership register, failing to identify the foreign parent as the ultimate beneficial owner, or processing SaaS payments through the SPC without any genuine commercial activity or compliance procedures.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fines under Oman's Anti-Money Laundering Law and tax administration law ranging from OMR 1,000 to OMR 50,000 per violation, possible deregistration, and mandatory corrective action orders.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers face criminal fines and imprisonment where the SPC is used as a vehicle to obscure ownership or shelter proceeds; travel bans and civil restitution may be ordered.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Crossing the OMR 1,000,000 related-party transaction threshold and failing to prepare, maintain, or submit the Local File and Master File, or failing to apply an arm's length method to inter-company SaaS royalties, license fees, or service fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Compulsory transfer pricing adjustment, disallowance of excessive deductions, additional tax, and administrative fines for non-production of documentation; repeat violations attract escalated penalties up to the maximum statutory amount.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The SPC's directors are personally liable if they knowingly certified false or incomplete transfer pricing documentation; restitution of the tax shortfall and travel bans may be imposed alongside fines.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Wilful Non-Filing and Obstruction of Tax Authority
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file Form CIT-1 within four months after the fiscal year-end, refusing access to accounting records, or obstructing tax audits while the SPC continues to distribute profits externally.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Assessments made by estimation, daily late-filing surcharges, late-payment interest on assessed tax, and fines up to the statutory maximum; authorization for enforced collection against bank accounts and receivables.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors cannot hide behind the SPC's limited liability; where non-filing is intentional, directors become personally liable for the assessed tax, costs, and civil restitution, and may be subject to travel bans and imprisonment.
